page.notes: Title page; no page number, running head, catchword or signature printed. Woodcut border (figure of a standing woman with a cup/sceptre inside an oval cartouche, with scrolled ornament) on the left: an engraving, not transcribed. Small oval printer's device on the right: its ring text is too faint to read, so it is not transcribed; the ring letters are not printed as text here. Handwritten annotations (a pencil or ink line in cursive below the author line, the "133" and "Ex" marks at the top right, and the scribbles at the bottom) are not printed text and are left out. "Digitized by Google" banner and the strike-through marks at the foot are left out. Spelling normalised: u/v and i/j per the rules (diversos, veritatis, JOANNIS, JACOBI, JAM-type forms); the printed "IAM" in the author line appears as "IAM" and is kept as printed because the line is capitals and the I reads as a vowel in the printed form. Printed "PETRVM" is read as PETRUM by the u/v rule.
